hint.move: Walk with WASD, look around with the mouse. Jump with {jump}. Talk to the owl at the end of the pier!
hint.glide: You're gliding! Let go and you'll start to fall.
hint.flapsOut: Out of feathers! They recharge when you touch the ground or water.
hint.shell: Seashells are Mr. Prickle's currency. Collect them, spend them!
hint.feather: A new Golden Feather! You can flap one more time in the air with {jump}.
hint.owlFlew: Sage the Owl flew to the lighthouse on the peak. The tall hill in the north!
hint.ready: {n} Star Shards! Go see Sage the Owl on Lighthouse Peak.
hint.current: The current is too strong, it pushes you back to shore.
hint.rescued: That was close! We carried you somewhere safe.
dlg.owl.intro: Hoo-hoo! Someone finally came! Welcome to Starfall Isle, little fox.
I'm Sage, keeper of the lighthouse. Last night's storm… blew it out!
Our lighthouse doesn't burn with ordinary light, but with starlight that fell from the sky.
The storm scattered that light across the island as thirty Star Shards.
Find at least twenty and we can light it again. Here, this Golden Feather will help you on your way.
dlg.owl.introAfter: Whoever carries a Golden Feather can jump once more in mid-air! Press {jump} while airborne.
Hold {jump} and you'll glide with your leaf. Don't be afraid of cliffs!
The more feathers, the higher you'll go. I'll be waiting at the lighthouse on the peak. Hoo-hoo!
dlg.owl.waiting: Hoo-hoo! You already have {n} shards, wonderful.
We need {need} more to light the lighthouse. Don't forget to help the islanders; they might be keeping shards too.
dlg.owl.ready: Oh my… {n} Star Shards! Their glow is dazzling.
If you're ready, shall we light the lighthouse together?
dlg.owl.after: The lighthouse shines over the island every night. All thanks to you, little fox.
By the way, you've found {shards}/{total} shards and {feathers}/{ftotal} feathers. The island may hold more surprises… Hoo-hoo!
dlg.hedgehog.hello: Oh, a new face! Welcome to Mr. Prickle's shop.
We trade in seashells. You'll find plenty on the beaches!
dlg.hedgehog.menu: What'll it be? You have {shells} shells.
dlg.hedgehog.soldOut: You bought everything I had! You're my best customer.
dlg.hedgehog.poor: Hmm, you need {need} more shells. Try the beaches!
dlg.hedgehog.bought.rod: Here's your rod! Face the water and press interact to cast.
Big Honey loves fishing, you'll find him by the shipwreck in the cove.
dlg.hedgehog.bought.feather: A Golden Feather! Careful not to bump your head on the sky!
dlg.hedgehog.bought.shard: I found this on the beach. It'll do more good at the lighthouse than with me.
dlg.hedgehog.bought.hat: That straw hat suits you! Drop by if you want to take it off.
dlg.rabbit.ask: Oh, hello! I'm Cotton. Three carrots escaped from my garden!
One went to the woods, one to the pink trees in the meadow, and one toward the lake.
Could you bring them back? I'll give you something very precious in return!
dlg.rabbit.progress: You found {n} carrots! Three ran away in total.
dlg.rabbit.thanks: I found this Golden Feather in the garden. It's yours!
dlg.rabbit.done: This time the carrots stay inside the fence. Promise!
dlg.beaver.ask: Hi! Chip the Beaver. I was building a bridge to the cove, but the storm blew my tools away.
Hammer, saw and shovel. One should be by the mushrooms, one near the windmill, one on the south beach.
Bring them back and I'll finish the bridge, promise!
dlg.beaver.progress: You found {n} tools. I need all three!
dlg.beaver.thanks: My tools! Getting to work right away…
Tap tap tap! There's your bridge! I found this between the planks, keep it.
dlg.beaver.done: Is the bridge sturdy? Of course it is, it's beaver work!
dlg.frog.challenge: Ribbit! I'm Hopper, the fastest frog on the island!
Race me to the yellow flag on the meadow hill? Win and a Star Shard is yours!
dlg.frog.rematch: Another race? This time I'll beat you, ribbit!
dlg.frog.win: Wow! Someone faster than me! A promise is a promise, here's your Star Shard.
dlg.frog.winAgain: {time} seconds! My legs are still shaking. Ribbit!
dlg.frog.lose: Ribbit ribbit! I won this time!
Try holding Shift to run, or gliding. I'll be by the lake if you want a rematch!
dlg.bear.norod: Hrmm… Fishing is the finest thing in the world.
No rod? You can get one from Mr. Prickle in the village.
dlg.bear.teach: Oh, you have a rod! Then let me teach you.
Face the water and cast with {key}. When the bobber dips, press {key} right away!
Then hold and release the button to keep the green zone on the fish. Catch three and I've got a gift for you.
dlg.bear.progress: You've caught {n} fish, {species}/{total} kinds. Some only bite at night or only in the lake, hrmm.
dlg.bear.reward3: This Star Shard got caught on my line one morning. It's yours now.
dlg.bear.reward6: All six kinds! Even I never managed that.
Here, I've been saving this Golden Feather for years.

quest.main.desc: Star Shards: {n} / {goal}. Then go to Sage the Owl on Lighthouse Peak.

hint.auroraReady: You have all 15 Aurora Crystals! Bring them to the Wise Owl at the observatory.
hint.boat: W to sail, A/D to steer, S to slow down. Press E near a dock to disembark.
hint.climb: Jump onto a vine wall to grab it ({jump} or push into it). Climb with WASD, {jump} to leap off. You fall when stamina runs out!
hint.climbTired: Your arms are tired! Rest and try again.
hint.dig: Press {key} on glittering soil to dig. Treasure maps are in your journal!
hint.house: This is your home! Decorate it at the corkboard, change outfits at the mirror.
hint.isle2: Welcome to Snow Island! The Wise Owl flew to the observatory — it's waiting for you on the summit.
hint.sail: Your boat has a sail now! Board it at the dock and sail northeast to Snow Island.

toast.hotspring: Ahh… warm water. Mina is relaxing.
toast.tool_sail: An old sailcloth! The beaver could use this.
toast.mitten: A huge red mitten… the polar bear's?

sign2.2: Please keep tails out of the pools. — The Management
dlg.owl.snow: Hoo-hoo… The night the lighthouse lit up, its beam reached far across the sea.
To the northeast I saw an island covered in snow! Lights were dancing in its sky…
Only a sailboat can get you there. Ask Master Beaver — he can fix anything!
dlg.owl.snowWait: Snow Island, to the northeast… I'll see you there, little fox. Hoo-hoo!
dlg.owl.crystals: This old observatory's telescope runs on Aurora Crystals.
You've found {n}/{total}. We need {need} more! Search every corner and help the islanders.
dlg.owl.crystalsReady: Let's repair the telescope and wake the sky…
dlg.owl.after2: Now we can see the northern lights from both islands. Wonderful, isn't it?
You've completed {n}% of your adventure. Who knows, there may still be hidden corners… Hoo-hoo!
dlg.beaver.sailAsk: Snow Island? Your boat needs a sail? Beaver work — consider it done!
But I need sailcloth… There was an old sail on the shipwreck's deck. Can you bring it?
dlg.beaver.sailProgress: The sailcloth should be on the shipwreck's deck. Check the cove!
dlg.beaver.sailDone: That's it! A few patches, a few knots… and done!
Your boat is a sailboat now. Fair winds, captain! Here, this cap is yours too.
dlg.beaver.sailAfter: How's the sail holding up? Strong, of course — beaver work!
dlg.mole.hello: Ah, an explorer! I'm Professor Mole, expert of all things underground.
Take this trowel: dig where the soil glitters and you'll find shells.
And this old treasure map… Find the X and dig! Each chest holds the next map.
dlg.mole.progress: {n}/{total} treasures found. The maps are in your journal — dig right on the X!
dlg.mole.done: All five treasures! A magnificent archaeological discovery!
You've earned this explorer hat. It looks just like mine, doesn't it?
dlg.mole.after: The earth always keeps a secret. If you see a glitter, dig!
dlg.cat.hello: Hi! I'm Foto, a traveling photographer.
I need six views for my exhibition: the lighthouse, the windmill, the shipwreck, a giant mushroom, the observatory on Snow Island and an igloo!
Press {key} for photo mode and take the shot. Keep them in the middle of the frame!
dlg.cat.done: Wonderful shots! My exhibition is ready!
Here, I found this crystal in an icicle on Snow Island. And some star glasses and a photo frame!
dlg.cat.after: The light is different every hour. Try a sunset photo!
dlg.penguin.challenge: Quack! I'm Waddle, the sled champion of Pine Slope!
Race me down to the lake? I'll slide on my belly, you take the sled!
dlg.penguin.win: Quack! You beat me! You flew like a snowflake!
A promise is a promise: this Aurora Crystal is yours. Use the sled any time!
dlg.penguin.winAgain: {time} seconds! My flippers are frozen. Quack!
dlg.penguin.lose: Quack quack! I won this time!
Follow the track with A/D on the slope, and don't brake with S! I'm here if you want another go.
dlg.seal.norod: Want to try ice fishing? You'll need a rod first. Check the hedgehog's shop on Starfall Isle!
dlg.seal.hello: Hello! I'm Marina. I love fishing through the ice holes.
Icefish, cod, salmon and the Aurora Eel that only comes out at night… Can you catch all four?
Stand at a hole and press {key} to cast.
dlg.seal.progress: {n}/{total} ice fish species. The Aurora Eel only bites at night!
dlg.seal.done: All four! You're a true ice angler!
Here, this crystal and this red scarf are yours. And a little fish tank for your home!
dlg.seal.after: So quiet under the ice, isn't it? The fish are dreaming down there.
dlg.goat.hello: Baa! I'm Cliff. Everything on this island is up high — even the observatory!
Let me teach you to climb vine walls: jump and grab, climb with WASD, {jump} to leap off.
If your arms get tired, you fall. Every golden feather adds stamina. First, reach the top of this training wall!
dlg.goat.progress: Climb to the top of the training wall! Your stamina is {stamina} seconds for now.
dlg.goat.done: Baa! Now that's a mountain goat spirit!
Here, I found this crystal on a peak. There's a ledge halfway up the observatory cliff — rest there!
dlg.goat.after: Who looks up, climbs up! Baa!
dlg.polarbear.hello: Welcome, little one! I'm Cloud, and this winter shop is mine.
Beanies, earmuffs, stoves… whatever you need! And… I lost my red mitten. It must be in a cave somewhere. I'd be so happy if you found it.
dlg.polarbear.menu: Anything catch your eye? You have {shells} shells.
dlg.polarbear.soldOut: The shelves are empty! You're my best winter customer.
dlg.polarbear.poor: You need {need} more shells, little one. Check the beaches!
dlg.polarbear.mittenThanks: My mitten! Paw-in-paw, toasty warm! Thank you, little one!
Here, this crystal — and a little fireplace to keep your home warm.
